verdict.rationale: Graphite lets you act on review findings in its own environment: you can apply suggested fixes in one click from the review page (graphite-docs-7, graphite-docs-50), and its built-in Agent commits changes straight to the PR branch (graphite-docs-22, graphite-docs-52). The only external link is Cursor, and it runs the other way: a Cursor Cloud Agent thread can be continued inside Graphite (graphite-docs-53), not review findings exported to Cursor. GT MCP lets agents create stacked PRs but is not shown passing review findings to them (graphite-docs-30). Missing for 10: copyable fix prompts, a documented handoff of review findings to Claude Code, Codex or local Cursor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
